name: Sakurai Kouichi
source:
[url=http://vndb.org/c1266]Ruka[/url]'s older brother. Completely opposite Ruka, Kouichi likes 'tough' vintage things, like motorbikes and 1960's American memorabilia. Ruka and Kouichi both seem to attract fights, and they are both skilled at hand-to-hand combat. Kouichi is a city boy, and likes loud, bright things and hanging around downtown.

[From [url=http://tokimekimemorialgs.wikia.com/wiki/Category:Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side_3rd_Story]Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side Wiki[/url]]
